facts_found: When a customer believes there is a discrepancy between cash back received and cash back that should have been received for a particular transaction, a cash back dispute is filed; the process applies to all credit card transactions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Dispute submission is done by the customer directly using the tool submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id, transaction_id); the agent confirms the correct transaction_id and does not collect sensitive card details. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Supporting context such as category or promotion expectations may be requested from the customer later during the dispute review, but submission is initiated with the tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]
After a cash back dispute is resolved and approved, the agent must update the affected transaction(s) with the correct rewards value. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Transactions requiring correction are identified by looking up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to find the transaction_id values needing rewards adjustments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

The internal agent tool for adjusting rewards is update_transaction_rewards_3847, which must first be unlocked with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool and then invoked with call_discoverable_agent_tool. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Rewards must be recalculated independently for each transaction based on card type, transaction category, and any applicable promotions; agents must not rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

update_transaction_rewards_3847 takes transaction_id (exact transaction identifier) and new_rewards_earned (a string formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

After calling the rewards update tool, the agent must confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Customer-facing policy: if cash back seems wrong (wrong rate, missing rewards, suspected merchant miscategorization), the service team reviews the specific transaction, verifies the merchant category, checks applicable reward rates for the card, and applies an adjustment if the customer was shortchanged. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Customers are asked to provide the transaction date, merchant name and purchase amount, cash back received vs. expected, and any receipts/documentation to support the investigation. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Silver Rewards Card guidance: use the card directly with the merchant (third-party wallets/processors may alter merchant classification), rewards are based on the merchant's submitted category, transactions must post before rewards are calculated, and receipts may be requested during a rewards review if a purchase is misclassified. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

A user's credit card dispute history can be retrieved with the agent tool get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), returning dispute_id, dispute_date, status (e.g., open, under_review, closed), last_updated_at, transaction details (transaction_id, merchant_name, amount, card_last4), reason_code, outcome and internal notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored) to the nearest whole number per purchase, consistently across all card types and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

All credit card rewards are stored internally as 'points' due to an incomplete backend migration; for cash back cards including Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card, 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]

No dedicated standalone 'rewards audit' tool is documented; auditing is performed by reviewing posted credit card transactions/merchant categories and the cash_back_disputes database, with the only adjustment tool being update_transaction_rewards_3847. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]
